remarks: Diamond in the rough! Come check out this great property located in the center of Norwalk. Minutes away from SoNo Collection as well of all town amenities; restaurants, parks, schools, grocery stores and more. This property offers an spacious living room with fireplace, formal dining room, eat in kitchen, 4 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, bonus room in main level, fully fenced yard and 2 car garage. Seller does not represent the legality of the in-law apartment, property is being sold in as-is conditions. Agents and buyers to do their own due-diligence.
